configurePresets.name: headless
configurePresets.description: Device-free backend; mirrors MAUI's *.Standard.cs. Fully unit-testable.

configurePresets.name: tidy
configurePresets.description: Headless build that runs clang-tidy over the library sources.

configurePresets.name: msan
configurePresets.description: Uninitialized-read lane. Requires Clang + instrumented libc++; NOT supported on AppleClang/macOS.

configurePresets.name: apple
configurePresets.description: macOS backend; mirrors MAUI's per-platform partials with real NSViews (.mm + ARC).

configurePresets.name: ios
configurePresets.description: iOS backend cross-compiled for the arm64 simulator; ctest runs the test binaries on a booted simulator via tools/ios-sim-run.sh (CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR).

configurePresets.name: maccatalyst
configurePresets.description: Mac Catalyst backend: the iOS UIKit handlers + host retargeted to the macabi ABI (arm64-apple-ios26.0-macabi via cmake/maccatalyst.toolchain.cmake), running NATIVELY on macOS. Matches .NET MAUI's own macOS rendering (Catalyst) for the strict 3-way visual-parity check.

configurePresets.name: android
configurePresets.description: Android backend cross-compiled with the in-SDK NDK 27.2 (LTS); ctest runs the test binaries on a headless emulator (dedicated maui-test AVD) via tools/android-emu-run.sh (CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR). ANDROID_NDK_HOME points vcpkg's android toolchain at the same NDK for the dependency builds (gtest/benchmark/pugixml under arm64-android).

configurePresets.name: ios-release
configurePresets.description: BOARD-CAPTURE build of the ios lane. Release, because the parity board compares the port against real MAUI and MAUI's own reference app is built Release: a Debug-vs-Release board measures build flags, not parity. The `headless` base stays Debug on purpose -- dev.sh, ctest and the sanitizer presets all inherit it and need assertions.
